items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against her and subjected her to a hostile work environment on the bases of disability (Major Depression, Recurrence, Somatic Symptoms Disorder, Generalized Anxiety, TIA, Myofascial Pain, Acute Stress Disorder) and reprisal (prior protected EEO activity) when: 1. 1.Beginning February 2021 to the present, she has been denied paid leave under the Family Medical and Leave Act (FMLA); 2.
On [MASK], a manager reassigned all of a retired co-worker’s complex cases to her; 3.
On [MASK], she was denied eight hours of paid FMLA sick leave; 4.
On [MASK], her final appeal of a requested reasonable accommodation was denied; and 5.
On [MASK], her supervisor denied her official time request to work on her EEO complaint.
